description: A JavaScript module for detecting conflicts in Font Awesome webfont and JS assets, including DOM readiness, conflict reporting, and iframe-based conflict detection.

methods.name: conflictDetection
methods.description: Main function to detect conflicts in Font Awesome assets, coordinating iframe tests and reporting results.

methods.name: detectWebfontConflicts
methods.description: Detects conflicts in webfont assets by analyzing <link> and <style> tags.

methods.name: detectSvgConflicts
methods.description: Detects conflicts in inline or external SVG/JS assets related to Font Awesome.

methods.name: setDoneResults
methods.description: Stores the results of conflict detection into the global FontAwesomeDetection object.

methods.name: pollUntil
methods.description: Utility function to poll until a condition is met or timeout occurs.
